subject: cipher
text: Dr. Jones realizes Hirocon said 'Was it a cat I saw? Was it a rat I saw?' which spells '?was I tac a ti saw' and '?was I tar a ti saw'.

evidence.quote: Dr. Jones: Hmm... Hirocon said... Was it a cat I saw? Was it a rat I saw?...?was I tac a ti saw. ?was I tar a ti saw. Get it?

subject: Dr. Jones
text: If you say yes: Dr. Jones says Hirocon is telling them to reverse the cipher, and tells Mike to get the Oxford Wonder World.

evidence.quote: (If you say yes)...Dr. Jones: Reverse! Exactly! Hirocon is telling us to reverse the cipher!...Mike, get the Oxford...Wonder World.. That's it there...

subject: Oxford Wonder World
text: When Mike shouts Paa Paa Paa Oom Papa Mow Mow, the book opens, and Mike slips to another time and space in Chapter 2.

evidence.quote: *You shout... Is it Paa Paa Paa Oom Papa Mow Mow?...Dr. Jones: Mike, wait! Stop... Stop!!!...(The book opens, and started flipping through pages.)...Left Page: ............... You slip to another time and space... ...Right Page: Chapter 2

subject: Chapter 2
text: A man warns that the ground has many holes a head hidden by snow, so watch your step.

evidence.quote: Man: The ground has many holes a head. They're hidden by snow. Watch your step.

subject: Tink
text: Tink makes tools from bones and stones and gives Mike an axe.

evidence.quote: Tink: I'm Tink. I make tools from bones and stones. Mike, try using my axe!...You've got an axe!

subject: Leader
text: The leader asks Mike the south paw reliever to drive Yum-Yum from their land after the man munching monster gulped down their children.

evidence.quote: A month ago... A man munching monster Yum-Yum gulped down our children....you to drive Yum-Yum from our land....reliever, can save us...

subject: Yum-Yum
text: A man warns that Yum-Yum lives to the north and hopes Mike has Tink's axe.

evidence.quote: Man: Yum-Yum lives to the north. Better not go there. So you're really going?...Hope you have Tink's axe.

subject: Shorty
text: Shorty thanks Mike after Yum-Yum is shown, stating Yum-Yum was trying to fatten them up.

evidence.quote: Shorty: Thank you! I'm Shorty. You really showed him, Mike!...Yum-Yum was trying to fatten us up...

subject: Chapter 2
text: After obtaining the block, Mike realizes he already has a tetrad, and his life level is increased.

evidence.quote: You've got a block! ... ...? ... ...??...Mike: That's it I already have a tetrad!...You've got a tetrad! Your life level is increased!

subject: Mica
text: Mica tells Mike that Hirocon wanted him to find the mystic tetrads hidden on Earth somewhere in time as the legacy of the Argonians.

evidence.quote: Hirocon wanted you to find the mystic tetrads. The tetrads were hidden on...Earth, some where in time... They're the legacy of the Argonians... Mike...please help us find the tetrads.

subject: Oxford World Wonders
text: Using the Oxford World Wonders again and saying the magic words Paa Paa Paa Oom Maw Maw transports Mike to Chapter 3.

evidence.quote: *Oxford World Wonders again...*and say the magic words... ...Paa Paa Paa Oom Maw Maw...Right Page: Chapter 3

subject: Chapter 3
text: Go north from where you appear, watch the right side of the screen for two palm trees, and walk in between them to find a path.

evidence.quote: Go north from where you appear. Watch the right side of the screen for two...palm trees. Walk in between them to find a path.

subject: Jack of all Trades
text: If you say yes: Jack of all trades trades his bronze dagger, giving you a dagger.

evidence.quote: (Jack of all Trades)...Jack: I'm Jack. Jack of all trades. I'll trade you for my bronze dagger. OK?...(If you say yes)...You've got a dagger!

subject: Jack of all Trades
text: If you talk to him with the dagger: Jack of all trades will trade you for his axe if you say yes.

evidence.quote: (If you talk to him with the dagger)...Jack: I'm Jack. Jack of all trades. I'll trade you for my axe. OK?...(If you say yes)...You've got an axe!

subject: Mica
text: Mica contacts Mike by telepathy, telling him that her father Hirocon, leader of the lost planet Argonia, spoke to her in a dream saying 'Was it a cat I saw? Was it a rat I saw?'.

evidence.quote: Mica: Mike! Pick up the phone! Just kidding... I'm using telepathy!...Mica: Remember my father, Hirocon, leader of the lost planet Argonia? He spoke...to me in a dream... Was it a cat I saw? Was it a rat I saw?
